steps.message:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-02, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 31374.7 | 20.07 | 20.07
2 | 7559.9 | 12.79 | 32.86
3 | 3573.3 | 1.62 | 34.48
4 | 313.2 | 38.90 | 73.38
5 | 53.6 | 0.41 | 73.79
6 | 22.8 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as K-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-02, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Report – Station T-02, Survey Area T**

The VES interpretation yields a six-layer resistivity model with values of 31,374.7, 7,559.9, 3,573.3, 313.2, 53.6, and 22.8 ohm-m at increasing depth, terminating in a conductive basement layer (22.8 ohm-m) below 73.79 m. Resistivity decreases monotonically through the entire sequence, with no layer exhibiting a resistivity increase relative to the one above it.

Applying standard curve-type notation to each three-layer window (1-2-3, 2-3-4, 3-4-5, 4-5-6) gives Q, Q, Q, Q — i.e., a pure Q-type curve (QQQQ), consistent with the steadily decreasing resistivity trend.

This does not match the on-file classification of K-type, which would require an intermediate resistivity increase (r1 < r2 > r3) not present in this dataset. The file label should be corrected to Q-type.
